findings.explanation: Item 1 is subsumed by Item 2. Item 2 already requires every logical output coordinate (x,y) with 0<=x<W and 0<=y<H to store at odata[y*P+x] the exact source binary32 element at floor_mod(y+shiftY,H), floor_mod(x+shiftX,W). That requirement entails bit-for-bit identity and already excludes interpolation, texture filtering, normalized-coordinate floating-point rounding, scaling, and numeric conversion for the specified output region. Item 1 therefore imposes no disjoint observable-output requirement; it overlaps with Item 2.
findings.required_change: Delete Item 1, or merge its exact-copy/no-conversion wording into Item 2 and remove Item 1 as a standalone item so the item set is non-overlapping.
